Subject: Weekly MAP standup: rotating owners & timezone sync

Hi Anna (and DataSpark team),

Thanks again for the productive evaluation last week. To keep momentum and make sure the close timeline stays on track, we'd like to set up a short weekly MAP standup. The goal: quick status updates, surface blocker(s), confirm owner for each next deliverable, and keep the evaluation plan aligned with your internal timelines.

Proposed cadence/options:
- 30 minutes, weekly (preferred)
- Tuesdays 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET (we can rotate if that conflicts with APAC folks)

Initial agenda (15–30 minutes):
1) Quick status (what shipped since last call) — 5m
2) Open blockers / asks (with owner/ETA) — 10m
3) Demo / evaluation artifacts alignment (if relevant) — 5–10m

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx (current owners & timeline), evaluation_criteria.pdf (scoring rubric).

If that works for you, I'll send a calendar invite and propose a rotation so different owners present each week (helps reduce single-point dependencies). If Tuesday doesn't work, let me know a window that does and we'll adapt.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
